name: MediaNexus – Media Suite
author: Astrid Web Technology LLP

sections.description:
MediaNexus lets you rename any media file and change its URL slug right from the WordPress media library – no FTP, no manual database edits, no broken links.

Simply open a media item, type in a new name, hit Save Changes, and the plugin takes care of everything automatically:

  • The file is renamed on the server.
  • All image sizes (thumbnails, medium, large, etc.) are renamed to match.
  • Every place on your site that links to or displays that file is updated instantly.
  • The URL slug can be changed separately from the filename.

Your pages, posts, and widgets keep working exactly as before – nothing breaks.

Key Features

  • File Rename – Give any media file a clean, meaningful name without touching your hosting or FTP.
  • Slug Edit – Change the URL-friendly name of any media item independently.
  • Nothing Breaks – Every link, image, and reference across your entire site is updated automatically.
  • Thumbnails Included – All automatically generated image sizes are renamed together with the original.
  • Works Everywhere – Rename from the media library popup or directly from the media edit page.
  • Safe & Secure – Only Editors and Administrators can rename files. All actions are verified to prevent unauthorized changes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the media-nexus-suite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any file in the Media Library – the Rename & Slug fields appear in the details panel.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the rename fields?

Go to your Media Library. In grid view, click any media item to open its details panel – you will see a Rename & Slug section near the bottom with a Save Changes button. In list view, click Edit on any item to open its edit page, where the same section appears.

Will renaming a file break my website?

No. The plugin automatically finds and updates every place that file is used – in posts, pages, menus, widgets, and page builder content – so nothing breaks.

Does it rename the different image sizes too?

Yes. WordPress creates several sizes of every image you upload (thumbnail, medium, large, etc.). When you rename a file, all of those sizes are renamed at the same time.

Who can rename files?

Only users with Editor or Administrator access can rename files.

Does it work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes. The plugin updates image references stored by page builders and widgets, not just standard post content.

Can I change the filename and the URL slug to different values?

Yes. The filename and slug fields are completely independent – you can change one, the other, or both at the same time.
